item.title: Modi’s Manila Visit Shapes Indo-Pacific Maritime Strategy
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
As geopolitical fault lines shift across the Indo-Pacific, Prime Minister Modi lands in Manila for the ASEAN-India and East Asia Summits. Here is how New Delhi is anchoring maritime deterrence and countering unilateral hegemony in the region.
[SPLIT] ⚡ The 2026 ASEAN-India Year of Maritime Cooperation prioritizes joint domain awareness and secure sea lines of communication. [SPLIT] ⚡ New Delhi's MAHASAGAR vision integrates economic connectivity with hard security postures in the Indo-Pacific. item.title: Starship’s Tower Catch Signals a New Era of Responsive Space Power
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
SpaceX's tower catch of the returning Starship isn't just a lunar milestone—it fundamentally redefines responsive space power, orbital asset reconstitution, and global strategic logistics.
[SPLIT] ⚡ Demonstrated payload deployment during orbital flight underscores the system's immediate utility for rapid satellite constellation replenishment. [SPLIT] ⚡ Super-heavy reusability shifts space deterrence, allowing defense forces to out-pace adversary anti-satellite denial through rapid orbital reconstitution.
